text: The geometric realisation |X| of a simplicial set X is constructed by:
choices: Taking the colimit of the diagram X_• over Δ
Gluing standard simplices |Δ[n]| according to the face/degeneracy structure of X
Taking the nerve of the category of elements
Taking the limit of the cosimplicial space
explanation: |X| = (∐ Xₙ × |Δⁿ|) / (face and degeneracy identifications); this is the coend X ⊗_Δ |Δ^−|.
